answers.core: I think that not permitting a SubViewport to contain the informations regarding the light management of its scene is a big limitation.
answers.workaround: I have not found a way to do it with a workaround. Thought about duplicating the scene and render it only with normal maps, or calculating the lights vectors impacting the viewport in real time to add a corresponding light in the 2D scene, but these solutions are inefficient and performance demanding.

title: When using a SubViewport to show 2D scenes the normal map information is lost.
